summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package's `preinstall` script (`node setup.mjs`) downloads a platform-specific Bun runtime from GitHub if not already installed locally, extracts it to a temp directory, marks it executable, and uses it to execute the bundled `math_init.js` — a ~727 KB single-line Bun-compiled module (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) that uses a rotating string-array decoder (`WV8StW`) over a large numeric table. `math_init.js` is not referenced by the ESLint plugin entry (`dist/index.js`) and is only reachable via the preinstall dropper. The package name and repository URL claim the `@servicetitan` scope and its `dist/index.js` mirrors a real ServiceTitan ESLint plugin, but the tarball adds this Bun-runtime dropper and opaque compiled payload that are unrelated to linting. Executing an opaque, obfuscated payload under a freshly downloaded alternate runtime at `npm install` time yields arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
